crewNotes.text: IMPORTANT: alcohol is illegal in Saudi Arabia. Do not carry any alcohol in hand or checked baggage - penalties are severe. Figures compiled from the cited ZATCA guidance and pending final authority review.

rules.text: Travellers must declare cash or equivalent monetary instruments of SAR 60,000 or more on entering or leaving Saudi Arabia.

declarationRequirements.text: Personal luggage and gifts of a personal, non-commercial nature up to a total value of SAR 3,000 are admitted duty-free; higher-value or commercial goods must be declared.

prohibitedItems.text: Alcohol and alcoholic beverages are strictly prohibited in Saudi Arabia and must not be brought in under any circumstances. Pork products and materials contrary to Islamic values are also prohibited.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
